limits: OneGPU/text only; 512MiB/32768token caps; complete MTP prefixes only.
Controlled full-first-logit and full-output parity is limited to tested prompts. No all-context/general-quality claim.
Automatic placements vary across restarts, including cold-vs-cold; first logits and whitespace differ. All seven semantic JSON oracles pass; no bitwise equivalence claim for these arms.
Three paired TTFT samples, no statistical population estimate or p99. Median reduction73.12% is ratio of the two medians; median paired saved time3.453s is a distinct statistic.
First creation TTFT9.625s, capture/write0.4779s. The whole difference against separate cold samples is not isolated as cache-write overhead.
